title: Willy And The Poor Boys
notes:
[l=RCA Records Pressing Plant, Hollywood] pressing denoted by "H" stamp in runouts.
Blue labels with gold print and "deep groove" pressing ring.
All runout data is stamped.

A1, A2, A4, A5, B1, B2, B3, B4, B5: Jondora Music-BMI
A3: Tro-Folkways-BMI

"Willy And The Poor Boys" appears on spine and front of sleeve; "Willy And The Poorboys" appears on back of sleeve and labels.

Label typesetting on this variant by Bert-Co Press, Hollywood.
